segments.comment: The gem variation of object-detect-cursed-potion-mimic-as-spellbook: on this seed set_mimic_sym() disguises the ^G giant mimic as a piece of worthless glass, the other type obj_is_generic() takes without a class. detect.c object_detect() (752-764) maps it through the cg.zeroobj copy, so it draws as a strange object ']'. The seed is the third of 128 consecutive seeds, from 512, on which the port stopped with a NaN glyph before it zeroed the copy, and the first of them with a gem disguise.
